signals.text: Doodle Bug On Friday the 23 rd January 2026, Ian Brealey from The Doodle Bug will be visiting school to work with the children, delivering workshop sessions which are Maths & Art Cross -Curricular and also linked to Mental Health, Well-Being & The Growth Mindset.

So far this term, we have been able to support our school with £3.7k towards several projects, including: The Outdoor Art project and the Felt Banners, The School trip to the Ashmolean Museum and part funding towards the training of our very own Therapy Dog.
Fresh Start Fresh Start will be visiting on Tuesday 6th January at the end of school, to offer children and parents some tasters from their new menu.
Please see the attached letter with details of our Autumn term clubs and how to sign up.

signals.text: Bank details are: North Marston School Association Account number: 49565054 Sort code: 23-05-80 As always, these events can’t run without the support of the whole community so if you are able to spare an hour to support the event on Thursday 4th December, please speak to a member of the PTA, or to Laura in the office.
This has been a real community project with funding being provided from The Rotary Club and the PTA and the shed being built by our handy man, Ben Pepper.
Nativity parts have been allocated and the PTA Bazaar is coming together so please keep an eye on communication coming out from school so that you don’t miss out on any vital information.

North Marston C of E School

pageCache.pageTitle: North Marston C of E School - Curriculum
pageCache.text:
Curriculum
At North Marston C E School we provide an exciting curriculum which builds upon the skills learnt previously and prepares them for their future learning.
All areas of learning are taught to provide continuity from YR to Y6.
Please look at the class pages to find out more about the topics and more specific learning which is happening within the school.
If you require any more information regarding the curriculum please speak to your child's class teacher or contact Miss Brew via the school office. office@northmarston.bucks.sch.uk
nm-intent-implementation-impact
Phonics and Reading
At North Marston we follow the validated "Little Wandle systematic synthetics programme". Please look on their website for further advice and support.
